projectsItems.name: Budgetory - Full stack web application for managing personal budget
projectsItems.description:
Budgetory is a full stack personal finance management application consisting of a Django REST Framework API, PostgreSQL database, and React frontend client. Application enables to:
• Create separate Wallets for mental grouping of financial instruments.
• Create Deposits inside of Wallets to represent particular financial instruments.
• Create Incomes, Expenses and its Categories.
• Create Periods and Expense Predictions.
• Track Budget with charts and tables.

projectsItems.name: Kindle-Clippings-CLI - CLI for managing Kindle clippings
projectsItems.description:
Kindle Clippings CLI is a simple, command-line interface tool for converting clippings from your Kindle device. It extracts your clippings from the My Clippings.txt file and provides an easy way to export the clippings into different formats.
• Extracts and parses highlights and notes from the Kindle My Clippings.txt file.
• Converts clippings into different formats (JSON and Excel at the moment).
• Lightweight and fast, designed for users comfortable with the command line.
